```{r Garch Analysis and Implementation}

# ============================================================================
# THESIS: GJR-GARCH-X ANALYSIS WITH LIKELIHOOD RATIO TESTS
# ============================================================================

library(rugarch)
library(readr)

setwd("/Users/simaovarandas/Desktop/DATA Thesis/R-Files")
train <- read_csv("train_data_for_R.csv")

cat("Training data loaded:", nrow(train), "observations\n")
cat("Columns:", colnames(train), "\n")
head(train)
summary(train[, c("Log_Return", "VIXScaled", "FearOrth")])


# ============================================================================
# MODEL 1: BASELINE GJR-GARCH
# ============================================================================

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("MODEL 1: BASELINE GJR-GARCH\n")
cat("========================================\n")

spec_baseline <- ugarchspec(
  variance.model = list(model = "gjrGARCH", garchOrder = c(1, 1)),
  mean.model     = list(armaOrder = c(0, 0), include.mean = TRUE),
  distribution.model = "std"
)

fit_baseline <- ugarchfit(spec = spec_baseline, data = train$Log_Return, solver = "hybrid")
print(fit_baseline)

baseline_ll   <- likelihood(fit_baseline)
baseline_aic  <- infocriteria(fit_baseline)[1]
baseline_bic  <- infocriteria(fit_baseline)[2]
baseline_npar <- length(coef(fit_baseline))

cat(sprintf("\nBaseline Log-Likelihood: %.4f\n", baseline_ll))
cat(sprintf("Baseline AIC: %.4f\n", baseline_aic))
cat(sprintf("Baseline BIC: %.4f\n", baseline_bic))


# ============================================================================
# MODEL 2: GJR-GARCH-X WITH VIX
# ============================================================================

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("MODEL 2: GJR-GARCH-X WITH VIX\n")
cat("========================================\n")

spec_vix <- ugarchspec(
  variance.model = list(
    model = "gjrGARCH", garchOrder = c(1, 1),
    external.regressors = as.matrix(train$VIXScaled)
  ),
  mean.model     = list(armaOrder = c(0, 0), include.mean = TRUE),
  distribution.model = "std"
)

fit_vix <- ugarchfit(spec = spec_vix, data = train$Log_Return, solver = "hybrid")
print(fit_vix)

vix_ll   <- likelihood(fit_vix)
vix_aic  <- infocriteria(fit_vix)[1]
vix_bic  <- infocriteria(fit_vix)[2]
vix_npar <- length(coef(fit_vix))

cat(sprintf("\nVIX Log-Likelihood: %.4f\n", vix_ll))
cat(sprintf("VIX AIC: %.4f\n", vix_aic))
cat(sprintf("VIX BIC: %.4f\n", vix_bic))
cat(sprintf("Improvement over baseline: %.4f\n", vix_ll - baseline_ll))


# ============================================================================
# MODEL 3: GJR-GARCH-X WITH FEARORTH
# ============================================================================

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("MODEL 3: GJR-GARCH-X WITH FEARORTH\n")
cat("========================================\n")

spec_fear <- ugarchspec(
  variance.model = list(
    model = "gjrGARCH", garchOrder = c(1, 1),
    external.regressors = as.matrix(train$FearOrth)
  ),
  mean.model     = list(armaOrder = c(0, 0), include.mean = TRUE),
  distribution.model = "std"
)

fit_fear <- ugarchfit(spec = spec_fear, data = train$Log_Return, solver = "hybrid")
print(fit_fear)

fear_ll   <- likelihood(fit_fear)
fear_aic  <- infocriteria(fit_fear)[1]
fear_bic  <- infocriteria(fit_fear)[2]
fear_npar <- length(coef(fit_fear))

cat(sprintf("\nFearOrth Log-Likelihood: %.4f\n", fear_ll))
cat(sprintf("FearOrth AIC: %.4f\n", fear_aic))
cat(sprintf("FearOrth BIC: %.4f\n", fear_bic))
cat(sprintf("Improvement over baseline: %.4f\n", fear_ll - baseline_ll))


# ============================================================================
# MODEL 3B: GJR-GARCH-X WITH RAW FEARSCALED (NO ORTHOGONALIZATION)
# ============================================================================

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("MODEL 3B: GJR-GARCH-X WITH RAW FEARSCALED\n")
cat("========================================\n")

spec_fear_raw <- ugarchspec(
  variance.model = list(
    model = "gjrGARCH", garchOrder = c(1, 1),
    external.regressors = as.matrix(train$FearScaled)
  ),
  mean.model     = list(armaOrder = c(0, 0), include.mean = TRUE),
  distribution.model = "std"
)

fit_fear_raw <- ugarchfit(spec = spec_fear_raw, data = train$Log_Return, solver = "hybrid")
print(fit_fear_raw)

fear_raw_ll   <- likelihood(fit_fear_raw)
fear_raw_aic  <- infocriteria(fit_fear_raw)[1]
fear_raw_bic  <- infocriteria(fit_fear_raw)[2]
fear_raw_npar <- length(coef(fit_fear_raw))

cat(sprintf("\nFearScaled (raw) Log-Likelihood: %.4f\n", fear_raw_ll))
cat(sprintf("FearScaled (raw) AIC: %.4f\n", fear_raw_aic))
cat(sprintf("FearScaled (raw) BIC: %.4f\n", fear_raw_bic))
cat(sprintf("Improvement over baseline: %.4f\n", fear_raw_ll - baseline_ll))
cat(sprintf("vs FearOrth model: %.4f\n", fear_raw_ll - fear_ll))


# ============================================================================
# MODEL 4: GJR-GARCH-X WITH VIX + FEARORTH
# ============================================================================

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("MODEL 4: GJR-GARCH-X WITH VIX + FEARORTH\n")
cat("========================================\n")

exog_both <- as.matrix(train[, c("VIXScaled", "FearOrth")])

spec_both <- ugarchspec(
  variance.model = list(
    model = "gjrGARCH", garchOrder = c(1, 1),
    external.regressors = exog_both
  ),
  mean.model     = list(armaOrder = c(0, 0), include.mean = TRUE),
  distribution.model = "std"
)

fit_both <- ugarchfit(spec = spec_both, data = train$Log_Return, solver = "hybrid")
print(fit_both)

both_ll   <- likelihood(fit_both)
both_aic  <- infocriteria(fit_both)[1]
both_bic  <- infocriteria(fit_both)[2]
both_npar <- length(coef(fit_both))

cat(sprintf("\nBoth Log-Likelihood: %.4f\n", both_ll))
cat(sprintf("Both AIC: %.4f\n", both_aic))
cat(sprintf("Both BIC: %.4f\n", both_bic))
cat(sprintf("Improvement over baseline: %.4f\n", both_ll - baseline_ll))


# ============================================================================
# MODEL COMPARISON
# ============================================================================

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("MODEL COMPARISON\n")
cat("========================================\n")

comparison <- data.frame(
  Model    = c("Baseline", "GJR-VIX", "GJR-FearOrth", "GJR-FearScaled", "GJR-VIX+FearOrth"),
  LogLik   = c(baseline_ll, vix_ll, fear_ll, fear_raw_ll, both_ll),
  AIC      = c(baseline_aic, vix_aic, fear_aic, fear_raw_aic, both_aic),
  BIC      = c(baseline_bic, vix_bic, fear_bic, fear_raw_bic, both_bic),
  N_Params = c(baseline_npar, vix_npar, fear_npar, fear_raw_npar, both_npar)
)
print(comparison)

cat("\nBest model by AIC:", comparison$Model[which.min(comparison$AIC)], "\n")
cat("Best model by BIC:", comparison$Model[which.min(comparison$BIC)], "\n")


# ============================================================================
# LIKELIHOOD RATIO TESTS
# ============================================================================

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("LIKELIHOOD RATIO TESTS\n")
cat("========================================\n")

cat("\nNote: LRT is the standard nested-model test for GARCH (MLE).\n")
cat("H0: the restricted model is adequate.\n")
cat("H1: the unrestricted model provides a significant improvement.\n")
cat("LR statistic = 2 * (LL_unrestricted - LL_restricted),\n")
cat("distributed chi-squared with df = difference in parameters.\n\n")

run_lrt <- function(ll_restricted, ll_unrestricted,
                    npar_restricted, npar_unrestricted,
                    label_restricted, label_unrestricted) {

  df      <- npar_unrestricted - npar_restricted
  lr_stat <- 2 * (ll_unrestricted - ll_restricted)
  p_value <- pchisq(lr_stat, df = df, lower.tail = FALSE)

  cat(sprintf("--- LRT: %s vs %s ---\n", label_restricted, label_unrestricted))
  cat(sprintf("  LR statistic       : %.4f\n", lr_stat))
  cat(sprintf("  Degrees of freedom : %d\n", df))
  cat(sprintf("  p-value            : %.6f\n", p_value))

  if (p_value < 0.01) {
    cat(sprintf("  Result: %s significantly improves fit over %s (p < 0.01)\n\n",
                label_unrestricted, label_restricted))
  } else if (p_value < 0.05) {
    cat(sprintf("  Result: %s improves fit over %s (p < 0.05)\n\n",
                label_unrestricted, label_restricted))
  } else if (p_value < 0.10) {
    cat(sprintf("  Result: %s marginally improves fit over %s (p < 0.10)\n\n",
                label_unrestricted, label_restricted))
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("  Result: %s does NOT significantly improve fit over %s (p = %.4f)\n\n",
                label_unrestricted, label_restricted, p_value))
  }

  return(invisible(list(lr_stat = lr_stat, df = df, p_value = p_value)))
}

# Test 1: Does VIX add value over baseline?
lrt_vix <- run_lrt(
  baseline_ll, vix_ll,
  baseline_npar, vix_npar,
  "Baseline", "GJR-VIX"
)

# Test 2: Does FearOrth add value over baseline?
lrt_fear <- run_lrt(
  baseline_ll, fear_ll,
  baseline_npar, fear_npar,
  "Baseline", "GJR-FearOrth"
)

# Test 3: Does raw FearScaled add value over baseline?
lrt_fear_raw <- run_lrt(
  baseline_ll, fear_raw_ll,
  baseline_npar, fear_raw_npar,
  "Baseline", "GJR-FearScaled"
)

# Test 4: Does FearOrth add value on top of VIX? (key research question)
lrt_both_vs_vix <- run_lrt(
  vix_ll, both_ll,
  vix_npar, both_npar,
  "GJR-VIX", "GJR-VIX+FearOrth"
)

# Test 5: Does VIX+FearOrth add value over baseline?
lrt_both_vs_base <- run_lrt(
  baseline_ll, both_ll,
  baseline_npar, both_npar,
  "Baseline", "GJR-VIX+FearOrth"
)

# Direct comparison: FearOrth vs FearScaled (non-nested, use AIC/BIC)
cat("--- Direct comparison: GJR-FearOrth vs GJR-FearScaled (non-nested) ---\n")
cat("  Note: same number of parameters, LRT not applicable. Use AIC/BIC.\n")
cat(sprintf("  FearOrth   LL: %.4f  AIC: %.4f  BIC: %.4f\n", fear_ll, fear_aic, fear_bic))
cat(sprintf("  FearScaled LL: %.4f  AIC: %.4f  BIC: %.4f\n", fear_raw_ll, fear_raw_aic, fear_raw_bic))
if (fear_raw_ll > fear_ll) {
  cat("  Raw FearScaled fits better in-sample than FearOrth\n")
  cat("  Interpretation: the VIX-overlapping component of sentiment adds in-sample fit\n\n")
} else {
  cat("  FearOrth fits better or equally - orthogonalization did not lose information\n\n")
}

# Save LRT results
lrt_table <- data.frame(
  Restricted   = c("Baseline", "Baseline", "Baseline", "GJR-VIX", "Baseline"),
  Unrestricted = c("GJR-VIX", "GJR-FearOrth", "GJR-FearScaled",
                   "GJR-VIX+FearOrth", "GJR-VIX+FearOrth"),
  LR_Statistic = round(c(lrt_vix$lr_stat, lrt_fear$lr_stat, lrt_fear_raw$lr_stat,
                          lrt_both_vs_vix$lr_stat, lrt_both_vs_base$lr_stat), 4),
  DF           = c(lrt_vix$df, lrt_fear$df, lrt_fear_raw$df,
                   lrt_both_vs_vix$df, lrt_both_vs_base$df),
  P_Value      = round(c(lrt_vix$p_value, lrt_fear$p_value, lrt_fear_raw$p_value,
                          lrt_both_vs_vix$p_value, lrt_both_vs_base$p_value), 6),
  Significant_5pct = c(lrt_vix$p_value < 0.05, lrt_fear$p_value < 0.05,
                        lrt_fear_raw$p_value < 0.05, lrt_both_vs_vix$p_value < 0.05,
                        lrt_both_vs_base$p_value < 0.05)
)

write.csv(lrt_table, "lrt_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("LRT results saved: lrt_results.csv\n")

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("GJR-GARCH-X ESTIMATION AND TESTING COMPLETE\n")
cat("========================================\n")
```

```{r}
# VISUALIZATIONS AND SUMMARY TABLES

setwd("/Users/simaovarandas/Desktop/DATA Thesis/R-Files")

library(ggplot2)
library(moments)
library(readr)

test <- read_csv("test_data_for_R.csv")
cat("Test data loaded:", nrow(test), "observations\n")

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("GENERATING VISUALIZATIONS AND TABLES\n")
cat("========================================\n")


# ============================================================================
# TABLE 1: MODEL PARAMETER COMPARISON
# ============================================================================

cat("\nCreating Table 1: Model Parameter Comparison...\n")

param_table <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c("mu", "ar1", "omega", "alpha1", "beta1", "gamma1",
                "delta_VIX", "delta_Fear", "shape"),
  Baseline = c(

    sprintf("%.6f", coef(fit_baseline)["ar1"]),

    "-", "-",
    sprintf("%.4f", coef(fit_baseline)["shape"])
  ),
  VIX = c(
    sprintf("%.6f", coef(fit_vix)["mu"]),
    sprintf("%.6f", coef(fit_vix)["ar1"]),

    sprintf("%.2e", coef(fit_fear)["alpha1"]),
    sprintf("%.6f", coef(fit_fear)["beta1"]),
    sprintf("%.6f", coef(fit_fear)["gamma1"]),

    sprintf("%.4f", coef(fit_fear)["shape"])
  ),
  FearScaled = c(

)

write.csv(param_table, "table1_model_parameters.csv", row.names = FALSE)
print(param_table)
cat("\nTable 1 saved: table1_model_parameters.csv\n")


# ============================================================================
# TABLE 2: MODEL FIT STATISTICS (includes Model 3B)
# ============================================================================

cat("\nCreating Table 2: Model Fit Statistics...\n")

fit_table <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Baseline GJR-GARCH", "VIX-GARCH", "FearOrth-GARCH",
            "FearScaled-GARCH", "VIX+Fear-GARCH"),
  LogLikelihood = round(c(baseline_ll, vix_ll, fear_ll, fear_raw_ll, both_ll), 2),
  AIC           = round(c(baseline_aic, vix_aic, fear_aic, fear_raw_aic, both_aic), 4),
  BIC           = round(c(baseline_bic, vix_bic, fear_bic, fear_raw_bic, both_bic), 4),
  N_Parameters  = c(baseline_npar, vix_npar, fear_npar, fear_raw_npar, both_npar),
  Delta_LL      = round(c(0, vix_ll - baseline_ll, fear_ll - baseline_ll,
                           fear_raw_ll - baseline_ll, both_ll - baseline_ll), 2)
)

write.csv(fit_table, "table2_model_fit.csv", row.names = FALSE)
print(fit_table)
cat("\nTable 2 saved: table2_model_fit.csv\n")


# ============================================================================
# TABLE 3: LIKELIHOOD RATIO TEST RESULTS (includes FearScaled, flags negative LR)
# ============================================================================

cat("\nCreating Table 3: Likelihood Ratio Test Results...\n")

# Note: FearOrth LR is negative due to numerical optimizer precision (LL slightly
# below baseline). p-value of 1.0 is correct: no improvement over baseline.
lrt_display <- data.frame(
  Restricted_Model   = c("Baseline", "Baseline", "Baseline",
                          "VIX-GARCH", "Baseline"),
  Unrestricted_Model = c("VIX-GARCH", "FearOrth-GARCH", "FearScaled-GARCH",
                          "VIX+FearOrth-GARCH", "VIX+FearOrth-GARCH"),
  LR_Statistic = round(c(lrt_vix$lr_stat, lrt_fear$lr_stat, lrt_fear_raw$lr_stat,
                          lrt_both_vs_vix$lr_stat, lrt_both_vs_base$lr_stat), 4),
  DF = c(lrt_vix$df, lrt_fear$df, lrt_fear_raw$df,
          lrt_both_vs_vix$df, lrt_both_vs_base$df),
  P_Value = round(c(lrt_vix$p_value, lrt_fear$p_value, lrt_fear_raw$p_value,
                     lrt_both_vs_vix$p_value, lrt_both_vs_base$p_value), 6),
  Decision = c(
    ifelse(lrt_vix$p_value        < 0.05, "Reject H0", "Fail to Reject H0"),
    ifelse(lrt_fear$p_value       < 0.05, "Reject H0", "Fail to Reject H0"),
    ifelse(lrt_fear_raw$p_value   < 0.05, "Reject H0", "Fail to Reject H0"),
    ifelse(lrt_both_vs_vix$p_value < 0.05, "Reject H0", "Fail to Reject H0"),
    ifelse(lrt_both_vs_base$p_value < 0.05, "Reject H0", "Fail to Reject H0")
  ),
  Note = c("", "LR < 0 due to optimizer precision; effectively zero improvement",
            "", "", "")
)

write.csv(lrt_display, "table3_lrt_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
print(lrt_display)
cat("\nTable 3 saved: table3_lrt_results.csv\n")


# ============================================================================
# TABLE 4: GARCH DIAGNOSTICS (WITH FORMAL TEST STATISTICS)
# ============================================================================

cat("\nCreating Table 4: GARCH Diagnostics...\n")

get_lb_stat <- function(fit, lag = 10, squared = FALSE) {
  resid_std <- residuals(fit, standardize = TRUE)
  if (squared) resid_std <- resid_std^2
  lb <- Box.test(resid_std, lag = lag, type = "Ljung-Box")
  return(list(stat = round(lb$statistic, 4), pval = round(lb$p.value, 4)))
}

get_arch_stat <- function(fit, lags = 5) {
  resid_std <- residuals(fit, standardize = TRUE)
  arch_test <- FinTS::ArchTest(resid_std, lags = lags)
  return(list(stat = round(arch_test$statistic, 4), pval = round(arch_test$p.value, 4)))
}

lb_base    <- get_lb_stat(fit_baseline, squared = FALSE)
lb_vix     <- get_lb_stat(fit_vix,      squared = FALSE)
lb_fear    <- get_lb_stat(fit_fear,     squared = FALSE)
lb_scaled  <- get_lb_stat(fit_fear_raw,   squared = FALSE)
lb_both    <- get_lb_stat(fit_both,     squared = FALSE)

lb2_base   <- get_lb_stat(fit_baseline, squared = TRUE)
lb2_vix    <- get_lb_stat(fit_vix,      squared = TRUE)
lb2_fear   <- get_lb_stat(fit_fear,     squared = TRUE)
lb2_scaled <- get_lb_stat(fit_fear_raw,   squared = TRUE)
lb2_both   <- get_lb_stat(fit_both,     squared = TRUE)

arch_base   <- get_arch_stat(fit_baseline)
arch_vix    <- get_arch_stat(fit_vix)
arch_fear   <- get_arch_stat(fit_fear)
arch_scaled <- get_arch_stat(fit_fear_raw)
arch_both   <- get_arch_stat(fit_both)

persistence_base   <- coef(fit_baseline)["alpha1"] + coef(fit_baseline)["gamma1"]/2 + coef(fit_baseline)["beta1"]
persistence_vix    <- coef(fit_vix)["alpha1"]      + coef(fit_vix)["gamma1"]/2      + coef(fit_vix)["beta1"]
persistence_fear   <- coef(fit_fear)["alpha1"]      + coef(fit_fear)["gamma1"]/2     + coef(fit_fear)["beta1"]
persistence_scaled <- coef(fit_fear_raw)["alpha1"]    + coef(fit_fear_raw)["gamma1"]/2   + coef(fit_fear_raw)["beta1"]
persistence_both   <- coef(fit_both)["alpha1"]      + coef(fit_both)["gamma1"]/2     + coef(fit_both)["beta1"]

halflife_base   <- log(0.5) / log(persistence_base)
halflife_vix    <- log(0.5) / log(persistence_vix)
halflife_fear   <- log(0.5) / log(persistence_fear)
halflife_scaled <- log(0.5) / log(persistence_scaled)
halflife_both   <- log(0.5) / log(persistence_both)

fmt_test <- function(stat, pval) {
  sig <- ifelse(pval < 0.01, "**", ifelse(pval < 0.05, "*", ""))
  sprintf("%.3f (p=%.3f)%s", stat, pval, sig)
}

diagnostics_table <- data.frame(
  Diagnostic = c(
    "Persistence (alpha + gamma/2 + beta)",
    "Shock half-life (days)",
    "Mean conditional volatility",
    "Leverage effect gamma1",

  ),

    sprintf("%.4f", coef(fit_fear)["gamma1"]),

    fmt_test(lb_fear$stat,   lb_fear$pval),
    fmt_test(lb2_fear$stat,  lb2_fear$pval),
    fmt_test(arch_fear$stat, arch_fear$pval)
  ),
  FearScaled_GARCH = c(

    fmt_test(lb2_both$stat,  lb2_both$pval),
    fmt_test(arch_both$stat, arch_both$pval)
  )
)
```

```{r}
corr_base_vix <- cor(fc_var_base, fc_var_vix)

mean_abs_diff <- mean(abs(fc_var_base - fc_var_vix))

cat(sprintf("Correlation between Baseline and VIX forecasts: %.6f\n", corr_base_vix))
cat(sprintf("Max absolute difference:                        %.10f\n", max_abs_diff))
cat(sprintf("Mean absolute difference:                       %.10f\n", mean_abs_diff))

if (max_abs_diff < 1e-10) {
  cat("\nWARNING: Forecasts are effectively identical.\n")
  cat("VIX regressors are NOT being incorporated in ugarchroll.\n")
  stop("Regressor verification failed. Rolling forecast is invalid.")
} else {
  cat("\nVERIFICATION PASSED: VIX and Baseline forecasts differ.\n")
  cat("Exogenous regressors are being correctly incorporated.\n")
}


# ============================================================================
# EVALUATION FUNCTION
# ============================================================================

evaluate_forecast <- function(actual_var, forecast_var, label) {

  valid_idx <- !is.na(forecast_var) & is.finite(forecast_var) & forecast_var > 0
  cat(sprintf("\n--- %s ---\n", label))
  cat(sprintf("  Valid forecasts: %d / %d\n", sum(valid_idx), length(forecast_var)))

  av <- actual_var[valid_idx]
  fv <- forecast_var[valid_idx]

  mse   <- mean((av - fv)^2)
  rmse  <- sqrt(mse)
  mae   <- mean(abs(av - fv))
  r2    <- 1 - sum((av - fv)^2) / sum((av - mean(av))^2)
  qlike <- mean(fv / av + log(av / fv) - 1)
  corr  <- cor(av, fv)

  cat(sprintf("  MSE:         %.10f\n", mse))
  cat(sprintf("  RMSE:        %.10f\n", rmse))
  cat(sprintf("  MAE:         %.10f\n", mae))
  cat(sprintf("  R-squared:   %.4f\n",  r2))
  cat(sprintf("  QLIKE:       %.6f\n",  qlike))
  cat(sprintf("  Correlation: %.4f\n",  corr))

  mz_reg     <- lm(av ~ fv)
  mz_summary <- summary(mz_reg)
  intercept  <- coef(mz_summary)[1, 1]
  slope      <- coef(mz_summary)[2, 1]
  p_int      <- coef(mz_summary)[1, 4]
  p_slope    <- coef(mz_summary)[2, 4]

  cat(sprintf("\n  Mincer-Zarnowitz Regression:\n"))
  cat(sprintf("    Intercept: %.8f (p = %.4f)\n", intercept, p_int))
  cat(sprintf("    Slope:     %.4f         (p = %.4f)\n", slope, p_slope))
  cat(sprintf("    R-squared: %.4f\n", mz_summary$r.squared))

  mz_ftest <- linearHypothesis(mz_reg, c("(Intercept) = 0", "fv = 1"))
  f_stat   <- mz_ftest$F[2]
  f_pval   <- mz_ftest$`Pr(>F)`[2]
  cat(sprintf("    Joint F-test (H0: alpha=0, beta=1): F = %.4f, p = %.4f\n", f_stat, f_pval))
  if (f_pval > 0.05) {
    cat("    Forecasts are unbiased (fail to reject H0)\n")
  } else {
    cat("    Forecasts are biased (reject H0)\n")
  }

  return(invisible(list(
    mse = mse, rmse = rmse, mae = mae, r2 = r2,
    qlike = qlike, corr = corr,
    mz_intercept = intercept, mz_slope = slope,
    mz_r2 = mz_summary$r.squared,
    mz_f = f_stat, mz_fp = f_pval,
    loss_mse   = (av - fv)^2,
    loss_qlike = fv / av + log(av / fv) - 1,
    valid_n    = sum(valid_idx)
  )))
}


# ============================================================================
# RUN EVALUATION
# ============================================================================

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("FORECAST EVALUATION\n")

metrics_base   <- evaluate_forecast(actual_variance, fc_var_base,   "Baseline")
metrics_vix    <- evaluate_forecast(actual_variance, fc_var_vix,    "VIX")
metrics_fear   <- evaluate_forecast(actual_variance, fc_var_fear,   "FearOrth")
metrics_scaled <- evaluate_forecast(actual_variance, fc_var_scaled, "FearScaled")
metrics_both   <- evaluate_forecast(actual_variance, fc_var_both,   "VIX+FearOrth")


# ============================================================================
# DIEBOLD-MARIANO TESTS
# ============================================================================

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("DIEBOLD-MARIANO TESTS\n")
cat("========================================\n")

cat("H0: No difference in forecast accuracy between the two models.\n")
cat("Negative DM statistic: first model is more accurate.\n\n")

run_dm <- function(loss1, loss2, label1, label2) {
  dm <- dm.test(loss1, loss2, alternative = "two.sided", h = 1, power = 2)
  cat(sprintf("--- %s vs %s ---\n", label1, label2))
  cat(sprintf("  DM statistic: %.4f\n", dm$statistic))
  cat(sprintf("  p-value:      %.4f\n", dm$p.value))
  if (dm$p.value < 0.05) {
    if (dm$statistic < 0) {
      cat(sprintf("  Result: %s is significantly more accurate (p < 0.05)\n\n", label1))
    } else {
      cat(sprintf("  Result: %s is significantly more accurate (p < 0.05)\n\n", label2))
    }
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("  Result: No significant difference in accuracy (p = %.4f)\n\n", dm$p.value))
  }
  return(invisible(list(stat = as.numeric(dm$statistic), pval = dm$p.value)))
}

cat("=== MSE Loss ===\n")
dm_base_vix_mse    <- run_dm(metrics_base$loss_mse,   metrics_vix$loss_mse,    "Baseline", "VIX")
dm_base_fear_mse   <- run_dm(metrics_base$loss_mse,   metrics_fear$loss_mse,   "Baseline", "FearOrth")
dm_base_scaled_mse <- run_dm(metrics_base$loss_mse,   metrics_scaled$loss_mse, "Baseline", "FearScaled")
dm_base_both_mse   <- run_dm(metrics_base$loss_mse,   metrics_both$loss_mse,   "Baseline", "VIX+FearOrth")
dm_vix_both_mse    <- run_dm(metrics_vix$loss_mse,    metrics_both$loss_mse,   "VIX",      "VIX+FearOrth")

cat("=== QLIKE Loss ===\n")
dm_base_vix_ql    <- run_dm(metrics_base$loss_qlike,   metrics_vix$loss_qlike,    "Baseline", "VIX")
dm_base_fear_ql   <- run_dm(metrics_base$loss_qlike,   metrics_fear$loss_qlike,   "Baseline", "FearOrth")
dm_base_scaled_ql <- run_dm(metrics_base$loss_qlike,   metrics_scaled$loss_qlike, "Baseline", "FearScaled")
dm_base_both_ql   <- run_dm(metrics_base$loss_qlike,   metrics_both$loss_qlike,   "Baseline", "VIX+FearOrth")
dm_vix_both_ql    <- run_dm(metrics_vix$loss_qlike,    metrics_both$loss_qlike,   "VIX",      "VIX+FearOrth")


# ============================================================================
# SUMMARY TABLES
# ============================================================================

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("OUT-OF-SAMPLE SUMMARY TABLE\n")
cat("========================================\n")

oos_table <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Baseline", "VIX", "FearOrth", "FearScaled", "VIX+FearOrth"),
  MSE   = round(c(metrics_base$mse,   metrics_vix$mse,   metrics_fear$mse,
                  metrics_scaled$mse, metrics_both$mse), 10),

                  metrics_scaled$rmse, metrics_both$rmse), 10),
  MAE   = round(c(metrics_base$mae,   metrics_vix$mae,   metrics_fear$mae,
                  metrics_scaled$mae, metrics_both$mae), 10),
  R2    = round(c(metrics_base$r2,    metrics_vix$r2,    metrics_fear$r2,
                  metrics_scaled$r2,  metrics_both$r2), 4),
  QLIKE = round(c(metrics_base$qlike, metrics_vix$qlike, metrics_fear$qlike,
                  metrics_scaled$qlike, metrics_both$qlike), 6),
  Correlation = round(c(metrics_base$corr, metrics_vix$corr, metrics_fear$corr,
                        metrics_scaled$corr, metrics_both$corr), 4),
  MZ_Slope = round(c(metrics_base$mz_slope, metrics_vix$mz_slope, metrics_fear$mz_slope,
                     metrics_scaled$mz_slope, metrics_both$mz_slope), 4),
  MZ_R2    = round(c(metrics_base$mz_r2, metrics_vix$mz_r2, metrics_fear$mz_r2,
                     metrics_scaled$mz_r2, metrics_both$mz_r2), 4)
)

print(oos_table)
write.csv(oos_table, "table6_oos_evaluation.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nTable 6 saved: table6_oos_evaluation.csv\n")

dm_table <- data.frame(
  Comparison = c(
    "Baseline vs VIX (MSE)",        "Baseline vs FearOrth (MSE)",
    "Baseline vs FearScaled (MSE)", "Baseline vs VIX+FearOrth (MSE)",
    "VIX vs VIX+FearOrth (MSE)",   "Baseline vs VIX (QLIKE)",
    "Baseline vs FearOrth (QLIKE)", "Baseline vs FearScaled (QLIKE)",
    "Baseline vs VIX+FearOrth (QLIKE)", "VIX vs VIX+FearOrth (QLIKE)"
  ),
  DM_Stat = round(c(
    dm_base_vix_mse$stat,    dm_base_fear_mse$stat,
    dm_base_scaled_mse$stat, dm_base_both_mse$stat,
    dm_vix_both_mse$stat,    dm_base_vix_ql$stat,
    dm_base_fear_ql$stat,    dm_base_scaled_ql$stat,
    dm_base_both_ql$stat,    dm_vix_both_ql$stat
  ), 4),
  P_Value = round(c(
    dm_base_vix_mse$pval,    dm_base_fear_mse$pval,

    dm_base_fear_ql$pval,    dm_base_scaled_ql$pval,
    dm_base_both_ql$pval,    dm_vix_both_ql$pval
  ), 4),
  Decision = ifelse(c(
    dm_base_vix_mse$pval,    dm_base_fear_mse$pval,

)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# NYBLOM PARAMETER STABILITY TEST
# ============================================================================
setwd("/Users/simaovarandas/Desktop/DATA Thesis/R-Files")

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("NYBLOM STABILITY TESTS\n")
cat("========================================\n")

extract_nyblom <- function(fit, label) {
  nb <- nyblom(fit)
  joint_stat <- nb$JointStat
  joint_cv5  <- nb$JointCritical[2]  # 5% critical value
  joint_cv10 <- nb$JointCritical[1]  # 10% critical value
  stable     <- ifelse(joint_stat < joint_cv5, "Pass", "Fail")
  
  cat(sprintf("\n--- %s ---\n", label))
  cat(sprintf("  Joint statistic:        %.4f\n", joint_stat))
  cat(sprintf("  Critical value (10%%):   %.4f\n", joint_cv10))
  cat(sprintf("  Critical value (5%%):    %.4f\n", joint_cv5))
  cat(sprintf("  Result (5%% level):      %s\n", stable))
  
  return(list(
    label      = label,
    joint_stat = round(joint_stat, 4),
    cv10       = round(joint_cv10, 4),
    cv5        = round(joint_cv5,  4),
    stable     = stable
  ))
}

nb_base   <- extract_nyblom(fit_baseline, "Baseline")
nb_vix    <- extract_nyblom(fit_vix,      "VIX")
nb_fear   <- extract_nyblom(fit_fear,     "FearOrth")
nb_scaled <- extract_nyblom(fit_fear_raw, "FearScaled")
nb_both   <- extract_nyblom(fit_both,     "VIX+FearOrth")

nyblom_table <- data.frame(
  Model          = c("Baseline", "VIX", "FearOrth", "FearScaled", "VIX+FearOrth"),
  Joint_Stat     = c(nb_base$joint_stat, nb_vix$joint_stat, nb_fear$joint_stat,
                     nb_scaled$joint_stat, nb_both$joint_stat),
  CV_10pct       = c(nb_base$cv10, nb_vix$cv10, nb_fear$cv10,
                     nb_scaled$cv10, nb_both$cv10),
  CV_5pct        = c(nb_base$cv5, nb_vix$cv5, nb_fear$cv5,
                     nb_scaled$cv5, nb_both$cv5),
  Stable_5pct    = c(nb_base$stable, nb_vix$stable, nb_fear$stable,
                     nb_scaled$stable, nb_both$stable)
)

print(nyblom_table)
write.csv(nyblom_table, "table_nyblom.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nNyblom table saved: table_nyblom.csv\n")
```

```{r}
setwd("/Users/simaovarandas/Desktop/DATA Thesis/R-Files")

library(readr)
library(entropy)

train <- read_csv("train_data_for_R.csv")

# ============================================================================
# ENTROPY ANALYSIS: FEARSCALED VS FEARORTH ACROSS MULTIPLE BIN SIZES
# ============================================================================

bin_sizes <- c(10, 20, 30, 50, 100)

results <- data.frame(
  Bins             = integer(),
  Entropy_FearScaled = numeric(),
  Entropy_FearOrth   = numeric(),
  Information_Loss   = numeric(),
  Percentage_Loss    = numeric()
)

for (bins in bin_sizes) {
  fs <- entropy(discretize(train$FearScaled, numBins = bins))
  fo <- entropy(discretize(train$FearOrth,   numBins = bins))
  loss    <- fs - fo
  pct     <- (loss / fs) * 100
  
  cat(sprintf("Bins: %3d | FearScaled: %.4f nats | FearOrth: %.4f nats | Loss: %.4f nats (%.2f%%)\n",
              bins, fs, fo, loss, pct))
  
  results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
    Bins               = bins,
    Entropy_FearScaled = round(fs,   4),
    Entropy_FearOrth   = round(fo,   4),
    Information_Loss   = round(loss, 4),
    Percentage_Loss    = round(pct,  2)
  ))
}

# Save to CSV for appendix
write.csv(results, "appendix_entropy_analysis.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nEntropy analysis saved: appendix_entropy_analysis.csv\n")

# View in RStudio
View(results)
```
